description: Marks up to 200 tasks done at once, as the Tasks page's selection bar does; each closes exactly as its own check box would. Kinds that close only from their own screen (lead follow-ups, flow steps, questions, staff check-ins, rules) are refused per task and reported in results. action "reopen" is the Undo. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the first answer and moves nothing again.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: complete_tasks_bulk
title: Mark several tasks done
